proposals.title: Two-week CRM context pilot
proposals.summary: Alice builds a small context intake and follow-up assistant for one anonymized CRM workflow; Bob provides operator feedback and pilot framing.

owner: Alice gets real B2B workflow feedback.
Alice validates the AI Secretary context exchange pattern in a CRM-adjacent use case.
counterparty: Bob gets a fast prototype for CRM follow-up quality.
Bob can test AI automation without exposing customer identities.

nextSteps.action: Ask Alice to approve sharing a private roadmap summary and available pilot scope.
Ask Bob to approve sharing an anonymized CRM workflow sample.
Draft a short intro message after both approvals.

reasons: Public context is sufficient for initial match.
Customer identities and private business data remain approval-gated.

proposals.title: Distribution feedback interview
proposals.summary: Bob gives Alice a structured 45-minute feedback session on positioning AI Secretary for B2B operators.

owner: Alice gets distribution and positioning feedback.
counterparty: Bob can influence a tool that may help his CRM automation goals.

nextSteps.action: Request approval from both owners to share calendar windows.
